THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF JONES, MAXINE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT VANCE, JENNIFER VANCE, LEROY L THE EVIDENCE DOES NOT SUPPORT THAT PLAINTIFF'S INJURY (IF ANY) RESULTED FROM A DANGEROUS CONDITION OF WHICH DEFENDANT WAS AWARE OR SHOULD HAVE KNOW ABOUT, BUT FAILED TO REPAIR.
